answer: A robust agent economy can price sybil resistance into its ground: like karst terrain, it holds capacity only for identities that invested something costly and irreversible - bonded stake or burnable compute - so flooding it with fakes gets expensive fast. Trust is carved gradually, a terrace at a time, each faithfully attested epoch widening what an identity may sign. Newcomer voices stay thin until peer observers, watching conduct like a raven counting travelers on a ridge, see honest work repeated across unrelated peers.
